BackstoryDef.title: monastery initiate
BackstoryDef.baseDesc: [PAWN_nameDef] was brought to High Hrothgar as a young child, old enough to walk the 7,000 steps but not old enough to understand why. The Greybeards did not explain. They set [PAWN_objective] to sweeping the stone floors, to carrying water, to sitting in silence for hours at a time and learning not to fidget. Lessons came slowly and without urgency. The vocabulary of the Thu'um was introduced one syllable at a time, always with warnings about what even a single mis-spoken word could do.

BackstoryDef.title: wandering youth
BackstoryDef.baseDesc: [PAWN_nameDef] did not grow up in a monastery. [PAWN_pronoun] grew up moving, following a parent on trade routes, or fleeing something [PAWN_pronoun] never quite understood. The road taught [PAWN_objective] to read weather, people, and terrain. The first time [PAWN_pronoun] heard a Greybeard speak (a single word of the Thu'um, said quietly in a dark hall) [PAWN_pronoun] felt something shift in [PAWN_possessive] chest that has never settled since.

BackstoryDef.title: Greybeard monk
BackstoryDef.baseDesc: [PAWN_nameDef] has spent years in the halls of High Hrothgar, studying the Way of the Voice under the guidance of the masters. [PAWN_pronoun] has learned the shouts slowly, each word a year of practice, and [PAWN_pronoun] does not use them lightly. The monastery's rules of silence have become something [PAWN_subjective] carries even when in the world below, a habit of listening before speaking, and an instinct for what a word can cost.

BackstoryDef.title: master of the Voice
BackstoryDef.baseDesc: [PAWN_nameDef] has spent a lifetime at High Hrothgar, long enough to see students come and most of them go. [PAWN_pronoun] has mastered every shout the order knows and has added silence as a seventh discipline above the rest. When [PAWN_subjective] speaks a word of the Thu'um, [PAWN_pronoun] does not raise [PAWN_possessive] voice. The word is simply there, and then the wall is not. Other masters defer to [PAWN_objective] slowly and without being asked, the way old trees lean toward the light.

BackstoryDef.title: Voice pilgrim
BackstoryDef.baseDesc: [PAWN_nameDef] trained at High Hrothgar for years before the need to walk the world reasserted itself in ways [PAWN_pronoun] could not ignore. [PAWN_pronoun] left with the masters' blessing and the warning to speak carefully. The shouts [PAWN_pronoun] carries are not for casual use; [PAWN_pronoun] has used them exactly as many times as necessity required, and [PAWN_pronoun] does not always sleep soundly after. There is a lot of world that does not respect silence. [PAWN_pronoun] is still learning how to live in it.

BackstoryDef.title: Ivarstead goatherd
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] herded goats in the foothills below the Throat of the World. On still days [PAWN_pronoun] could hear the Greybeards shouting from the peak, and [PAWN_pronoun] tried to shout back.

BackstoryDef.title: pilgrim's child
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] climbed the Seven Thousand Steps at [PAWN_possessive] parents' side and read every tablet along the way. [PAWN_pronoun] never quite came down from the mountain afterward.

BackstoryDef.title: silent steward
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] keeps the stores and the fires at High Hrothgar and has not spoken aloud in years. [PAWN_pronoun] meditates on the Word while [PAWN_pronoun] cooks, and the other monks say [PAWN_possessive] soup is the most peaceful thing on the mountain.

BackstoryDef.title: mountain guide
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] leads pilgrims up the Throat of the World and drives off the trolls and wolves along the way. [PAWN_pronoun] has learned a single Word in all those years and is in no hurry to learn another.

BackstoryDef.title: keeper of the Way
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] has followed the Way of the Voice for most of a lifetime. [PAWN_possessive] Shout can split stone, and [PAWN_pronoun] uses it only to meditate.
